dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Emma, you look happy today! Did you and Ryan make up?
dialogue.reading: ˈɛmə, juː ˈlʊk ˈhæpi təˈdeɪ! dɪd juː ənd ˈraɪən ˈmeɪk ˈʌp?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Yes! We talked for three hours last night, and we said sorry to each other.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs! wiː ˈtɔːkt fər ˈθriː ˈaʊərz ˈlæst ˈnaɪt, ənd wiː ˈsɛd ˈsɑːri tu ˈiːtʃ ˈʌðər.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I'm happy for you. What did you decide?
dialogue.reading: aɪm ˈhæpi fər juː. ˈwʌt dɪd juː dɪˈsaɪd?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: We need to communicate better. We should tell each other when something is wrong.
dialogue.reading: wiː ˈniːd tə kəˈmjuːnɪkeɪt ˈbɛtər. wiː ʃʊd ˈtɛl ˈiːtʃ ˈʌðər wɛn ˈsʌmθɪŋ ɪz ˈrɔːŋ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: That's important. Good partners listen to one another.
dialogue.reading: ðæts ɪmˈpɔːrtənt. ˈɡʊd ˈpɑːrtnərz ˈlɪsən tə ˈwʌn əˈnʌðər.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: He'll play video games only on weekends, and I won't get angry when he does.
dialogue.reading: hiːl ˈpleɪ ˈvɪdioʊ ˌɡeɪmz ˈoʊnli ɑːn ˈwiːkɛndz, ənd aɪ ˈwoʊnt ˈɡɛt ˈæŋɡri wɛn hiː ˈdʌz.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: That sounds fair. My parents are a great couple. They always support each other.
dialogue.reading: ðæt ˈsaʊndz ˈfɛr. maɪ ˈpɛrənts ər ə ˈɡreɪt ˈkʌpəl. ðeɪ ˈɔːlweɪz səˈpɔːrt ˈiːtʃ ˈʌðər.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: How long have they been married?
dialogue.reading: ˈhaʊ ˈlɔːŋ hæv ðeɪ bɪn ˈmærid?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Twenty-five years! And they still help each other every day.
dialogue.reading: ˈtwɛnti ˈfaɪv ˈjɪrz! ənd ðeɪ ˈstɪl ˈhɛlp ˈiːtʃ ˈʌðər ˈɛvri ˈdeɪ.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: That's lovely. I hope Ryan and I are like that one day.
dialogue.reading: ðæts ˈlʌvli. aɪ ˈhoʊp ˈraɪən ənd aɪ ər laɪk ˈðæt ˈwʌn ˈdeɪ.
